models_evaluated: contactless rPPG AI-based vital signs screening device

links.outcome: Agreement of AI contactless vitals with automated and manual reference measurements in local patients
links.effect: No significant differences for respiratory rate and oxygen saturation (p>0.05); significant differences for heart rate, SBP, DBP vs automated device (p<0.05); BP limits of agreement ±30 mmHg SBP, ±20 mmHg DBP.
links.quote: There were no significant differences between the contactless AI-based device system and automated or manual measurements for respiratory rate and oxygen saturation (p > 0.05).

screen.reason: Prospective cross-sectional evaluation of an AI-based contactless rPPG vital signs screening system with 499 real dental patients, assessing measurement accuracy and patient perceptions.
